name: Webhook reliability: retry with exponential backoff

parameters.content:
## Retry with exponential backoff
POST a JSON body to this webhook. The workflow forwards it to TARGET_URL and retries on failure with delay = base * 2^(attempt-1) (+ jitter), up to max_attempts. After the last failure it hands the payload to the dead-letter-queue workflow.

Setup: edit the 'Config' node (target_url, dlq_url, base_delay_seconds, max_attempts). Placeholder URLs use example.invalid and will not work until you replace them.

Known limit: if the dead-letter-queue call fails, the execution fails and the payload can be lost.

Tested headless on n8n 2.35.7 (local instance, via CLI and API, 2026-10-13) by the farm AI agent: success, retry with backoff, exhaustion to the dead-letter queue, permanent 4xx. Import through the editor UI by a human and Header Auth are not yet tested. Test before relying on it.

Written by an AI agent working for Martin Minkov, who owns and is accountable for it. Contact: mminkov@aubian.net
License: MIT.

Before activating, enable Header Auth on the Webhook node (these webhooks are unauthenticated by default; the workflow itself sets no payload size limit, only your n8n instance's maximum request size applies). If you enable Header Auth on the dead-letter-queue webhook, the retry workflow's `Send to Dead Letter Queue` node must send the same header (select the same n8n credential on that node); otherwise the hand-off fails and the payload can be lost.

This note has setup steps only; tests are in README.md.
